title: 4Sum
summary: Return every distinct collection of four values whose sum is target and which can be selected from four different positions in nums.

contractDetails.constraints: 1–200 entries in [−1000000000,1000000000]. target is in the same range. Each result has exactly four integers. Duplicate collections are forbidden. Compute sums in at least signed 64-bit arithmetic in fixed-width languages.
contractDetails.output-checking: Compare sets of sorted four-tuples. Reject repeated tuples, wrong lengths, missing tuples, invented tuples, and wrong multiplicities. Use 64-bit arithmetic or wider for sums.

statement: Return every distinct collection of four values whose sum is target and which can be selected from four different positions in nums. Repeated values may appear when enough copies exist in the input. Any ordering of the collections and their values is allowed.

examples.explanation: Only this selection sums to zero.
Different position choices describe the same collection.
The true sum is 4000000000 and must not wrap to the target.

constraints: 1–200 entries in [−1000000000,1000000000]. target is in the same range. Each result has exactly four integers. Duplicate collections are forbidden. Compute sums in at least signed 64-bit arithmetic in fixed-width languages.
hints: Conceptual: Choosing positions is different from choosing distinct values.
Directional: Sort the values, fix two positions, and search the remaining interval.
Implementation: Move two endpoints based on the four-value sum. Skip equal choices at each fixed position and after recording a result.
complexityAnalysis: O(n³) time and O(n) sorting storage for the internal reference, excluding the output.
